name: Present Play
source:
In this game, you pick a costume and an actress, then a story starts. In the beginning, there is only one girl and few costumes. In stories, you can fine two other girls and more costumes. If you make it far enough in a story, you will see an animation of the girl getting rid of her costume.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
玩家先选择一套服装和一名女演员，故事随后开始。起初只有1名女孩与少量服装可选。在各段故事中，玩家能够找到另外2名女孩，解锁更多服装。只要在剧情中推进得足够远，就能看到女孩脱去服装的动画。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
